CustomField.label: Business Owner
CustomField.description: The Salesforce user who is accountable for this integration from the business side, such as a department head or process owner who understands why the integration exists and what business outcome it supports. Contact this person, in addition to the Technical Owner, before making a change that could disrupt a High criticality integration.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The person accountable for this integration on the business side.
